title: What Are Embeddings? Words as Points on a Map
description:
An embedding is a list of numbers that places a word as a point in space, so similar meanings sit close together and AI can measure meaning with distance for search, clustering and recommendations.

The coordinates, positions and distances shown are illustrative, and real embeddings typically use many more dimensions than the animation shows.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
